---
title: "`r params$project`"
subtitle: "`r params$subtitle`"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    theme: none
    css: report.css
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  data_folder: ""
  pipeline: "images"
  project: ""
  subtitle: ""
---

```{r setup}
library(cehbio)
d <- read_report_data(params$pipeline, params$project, folder = params$data_folder)
t <- d$text
lab <- t$labels
deps <- d$deployments[order(d$deployments$deployment_id), ]
```

::: {.note}
`r t$methods$caveat`
:::

## Summary

```{r headlines, results="asis"}
cat(paste0("- ", t$project_summary, collapse = "\n"))
```

## Deployments

```{r table}
knitr::kable(data.frame(deployment = deps$deployment_id, `first night` = deps$first_night,
                        `last night` = deps$last_night, nights = deps$nights_worked,
                        hours = round(deps$hours_worked), individuals = format(deps$individuals, big.mark = ","),
                        `species / groups` = deps$taxa, check.names = FALSE), align = "lllrrrr", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r per-hour, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=2.4}
s <- report_style(d)
per <- ifelse(deps$hours_worked > 0, deps$individuals / deps$hours_worked, 0)
cehbio:::.hbars(deps$deployment_id, round(per, 1), paste(lab$unit, "per hour working"), s)
```

Average activity per hour working. Deployments ran on different nights and places, so this describes them; it doesn't rank them.

```{r links, results="asis"}
cat(paste0("[", deps$deployment_id, "](", deps$deployment_id, ".html)", collapse = " · "))
```

## How this was done

```{r methods, results="asis"}
m <- t$methods
cat(m$how, "\n\n", m$unit, "\n\n", m$night, "\n\n", m$weather, m$moon, "\n\n")
if (length(m$models)) cat("Models used:\n\n", paste0("- ", m$models, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
if (length(m$citations)) cat("Please cite:\n\n", paste0("- ", m$citations, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
cat("[", m$made_with, " Report made in R.]{.small}\n", sep = "")
```
